sentences.text:
Kuljit Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11
April, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 10973 of 2025

Applicant :- Kuljit Singh And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Arun Kumar Sharma,Sanjay Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Sanjay Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned
Aga for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed for quashing the charge sheet dated 27.07.2022 as well as
cognizance order dated 26.11.2022 including the entire proceedings of Case No.1166 of 2022, arising
out of Case Crime No.593 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station Anupshahr, District Bulandshahr, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial
Magistrate, Bulandshahar.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in
nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise.

The
aforesaid compromise dated 07.08.2024 is reduced in writing and annexed at page 85 of the affidavit.

It has been requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of Kuljit Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41050916/
1 aforesaid compromise.
4.

entities.text: Kuljit Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Though this fact has not been disputed by learned AGA but he has raised a preliminary objection that the aforesaid proceeding cannot be quashed on the basis of compromise.
The aforesaid compromise should be verified by the court below before quashing the impugned proceeding.
5. In view of the above, the applicants are directed to file original deed of the compromise before the court below within a period of 15 days from today.

On filing of such compromise, the court below will verify the same within a period of two months after summoning the parties and after verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
6. For a period of two and half months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
7. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
8. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 11.4.2025 A.Kr.
